name: ramose
description: Ramose — an immutable, Datomic-inspired database for Cloudflare (Workers + Durable Objects + R2).
author: Tyler van Hensbergen <tvanhens@gmail.com>

scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/storage packages/transactor packages/replica packages/worker packages/alchemy packages/react packages/better-auth examples/todos examples/reef test/support
scripts.dev: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy dev
scripts.dev:todos: CI=${CI:-1} ALCHEMY_STATE=${ALCHEMY_STATE:-local} CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef} CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-x} bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy dev examples/todos/alchemy.run.ts
scripts.dev:reef: CI=${CI:-1} ALCHEMY_STATE=${ALCHEMY_STATE:-local} CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef} CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-x} bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy dev examples/reef/alchemy.run.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy deploy
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy deploy --stage prod
